engine.description: Agent engine used to author the Remotion project. M1 only ships the codex engine; claude-code and remote-worker are reserved for M2.

outputRootAllowlist.description: Absolute directories where AI workspaces may be created. If empty, any user-provided output root is accepted (subject to traversal checks). The generated project directory is NEVER auto-added to the remotion plugin's templateRoots.

retryMax.description: Maximum retries for the validation loop. Each retry re-prompts the same agent session with the failure digest.

jobTimeoutMs.description: Hard upper bound on a single AI Create job in milliseconds (default: 10 minutes). Covers the full agent + validation loop.

skillsBundled.description: If true, the ai-starter template ships with Remotion Agent Skills vendored at build time (offline-capable, pinned version). If false, skills are omitted and the agent must rely on its own knowledge.

starterDir.description: Absolute path to the ai-starter template directory. Defaults to the bundled remotion-templates/ai-starter.

allowNetwork.description: If false (default), the headless Chromium used during validation blocks all network requests. Mirrors the remotion plugin's behavior.

chromiumExecutablePath.description: Override the Chromium executable used by the validation render worker. Defaults to the one bundled with @remotion/renderer.

maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum allowed size of the validation still PNG in bytes (default: 10 MiB). Oversized outputs fail the validation step.
